title: Firekeeper transcript event
description: One normalized transcript event. The idempotency key is (machine_id, session_id, seq). Kept in sync with transcript.Event by internal/transcript/schema_test.go.

seq.description: Zero-based index of the event in its source; identical on every re-read. Line index for JSONL, row order by a stable key for SQLite.

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp, or null when the source has none.

role.description: Records a parser cannot interpret are emitted with role meta, never dropped.

text.description: What a human would read; may be empty. Tool output longer than 64 KiB ends with a [truncated N bytes] marker.

raw.description: The original record after redaction, untruncated.
